These boots 🥾 are made for walking... Get started as an orderpicker at Timberland, earning up to € 18.259 💸! You will ensure our customers receive their orders on time and in perfect condition! As an orderpicker you will work in Timberland's large distribution center. Together with your colleagues, you will start your day with a nice cup of coffee.
